context_notes: Phase 3 is verified with exactly ONE blocker gap, CR-01, and the fix is narrow. `platform/git.ts::listRemotes` line 368 returns `{ kind: "origin", url: origin.url }` without checking that origin.url is a string. isomorphic-git's _listRemotes (node_modules/isomorphic-git/index.cjs:13043-13053) resolves `remote.<name>.url` as an independently-absent lookup, so a `.git/config` holding `[remote "origin"]` with a fetch line and no url key yields `{ remote: "origin" }` and the wrapper returns url: undefined — violating its own declared ListRemotesResult type. add.ts::recognizeLeftover (~line 725) then calls stripGitSuffix(remotes.url) and throws a raw TypeError that matches none of classifyAddError's instanceof arms and carries no .code, so handleAddFailure re-throws it raw in standalone mode (breaking ATTR-07) and degrades it to reason 'unparseable' in orchestrated mode instead of 'stale clone'. The shape is reachable from exactly the WR-07 crash window this phase exists to recover from. The 100%-branch gate cannot catch it because the missing behavior is a MISSING branch, and createGitOpsFake's listRemotesResult is typed ListRemotesResult so the fake cannot express url: undefined at all — a fake-only test cannot close this gap. Fix direction the verifier endorsed: return { kind: "no-origin" } for a present-but-url-less origin, plus a real-filesystem test in tests/platform/git.test.ts and an add.test.ts case covering both standalone and orchestrated mode. Editing platform/git.ts also invalidates SC4's evidence (which rests on `git diff --name-only 50746b81..HEAD -- ':!.planning/'` being empty), so the gap plan owes a closing whole-gate run with a captured exit code.
